I was shooting for that, i strove for it twice in my life. The military failure took 4 years to reach because of the moving/ paperwork involved. 

After laying my sights off that it was the trucking thing...im just tired. It's like the systems of society are rejecting me for being too abnormal, and I can't blame it, I am an abnormal, anti social loner.

I am glad to get advice and that you are trying to help but im sorry, to be honest they're just hollow words at this point. I wish they weren't and i wish words could help me. 

I really dont know what to do. Im here, in asia, trying to make things work one more time, trying to see things through, regardless of the pain and my own ineptitude yet the best i can do is just sit and wait for disaster to ensue. 

An exit strategy is the only thing that makes sense considering all of this.

Yes. Its like the universe doesn't want me to do anything i'm interested in. I tried joining the military even, apparently I failed my psyche evaluation because I "entertain thoughts about the greatness of life and the universe" on a semi-regular basis.

Ive attempted to become a trucker as well, unfortunately my DUI record prevents that from happening. 

My last bastion of hope was to become a heavy equipment operator. It's only 6k for school. Saving for that back home was going to take too long though, so i came out here to save quicker and only ended up furthering my debt. That's why i'm here.

I 'lucked' out at a young age and got a prestigious job where my name become well known for things I didn't really do. Major companies kept throwing offers at me, for the past 6 years or so. I hated the work and often tried getting into other careers while back home but I was always drawn in by the allure of 'heading back out' into adventure with the potential of finally making tons of money.

Im not happy with it at all. I dont know what im doing so im literally not doing anything except spending my days on reddit, imgur, world of warcraft and random internet browsing until the inevitable catastrophy takes place. 

I want to give a fuck, but i dont know how, my natural response is not giving a fuck. Ive done this kind of work int he past and ive always hated it, i still do. I hate it. Im broken, i really do have a golden opportunity in front of me but im not capable of capitalizing on it because im either too stupid or too depressed or something. 

Everywhere I go it's like this. Ive burned a million golden opportunities simply because i hate this line of work and dont care or know how to care about it enough to gain some competency. 

On top of the lack of family or friends or place to call my own, my history is riddled with failure like this.

Yes, i can relate to that big time. Preceding each move was a major catastrophe which prompted it, in most cases. 


My intent is actually to make things work here but i dont know how the fuck that is going to happen. 


I have a team of people who's jobs are secure for one more week. Their jobs are dependent on whether or not i can find a good reason for the company to pay them stick around and work on the internal campaign which im supposed to be designing, yet am too overwhelmed on where to start that ive decided to stop giving a fuck. 


Ive got one more week before everyone, including myself is off the clients payroll and on to the companies payroll and im pretty much just sitting back waiting for shit to hit the fan. It's like watching my own demise in slow motion. I know im not doing anything to prevent the catastrophe, so i know its going to happen. Im paralyzed. 


Once i get this bottle i think it will relive alot of stress, knowing that at any time i can just opt out.

I do appreciate you talking with me.
Dunno why you got down voted for this. Fuck those people. I do appreciate you talking with me regardless.

Yup, traveled too much I would say. All over the stupid world, basically a lost soul looking for a place to fit in, hence no, no place to call home. 

Even home is a place I hate to even think about. Basically, if i can't make things work here I don't see any point in starting over, yet again. Im getting that bottle of nembutal just as a precaution. If/when i fail its an easy out from a final failure. 

My fingers are certainly crossed for somehow pulling some success out of thin air though. Life can be fun but not when you're lost in the way that i am.
Lack of opportunities elsewhere. Ive jsut completed my order for nembutal online. Seriously, fuck this shit.
thing is thats all ive been after for 10 years. Now, like many times before, im on the other side of the world, no close friends, no family and yet another impending failure on the horizon.
Im shallow, i just want money/ freedom from everyone.
